title: ArXiv receives multiyear commitments to support it as an independent nonprofit
summary: ArXiv has secured multiyear financial commitments to maintain its status as an independent nonprofit organization, ensuring the continued free access to millions of academic preprints across physics, mathematics, computer science, and other disciplines.
problem_solved: Addresses the sustainability and funding uncertainty that threatens open-access scientific research infrastructure.
why_valuable: Secures the future of a critical research tool used by millions of academics worldwide, preserving academic freedom and open science principles.
